name: Durable Objects
summary: Durable Objects are Cloudflare Workers with a globally unique name and their own strongly consistent storage, now backed by an embedded SQLite database per object. Cloudflare's Agents SDK runs each agent instance as a Durable Object, persisting its state and SQL data across evictions. Alarms and WebSocket hibernation let an agent wake on a schedule or hold client connections.
facts: SQLite per object (required for new namespaces since July 2026)
10 GB per object on Workers Paid
Soft limit of 1,000 requests/s per object
Agent class extends Server, which extends DurableObject
Free plan; Paid $0.15/M requests, $0.20/GB-month stored beyond inclusions
goodFor: One stateful actor per agent, user or chat
watchOut: Each object is single-instance; hot objects hit per-object throughput limits
Cross-object queries need a separate database
